fmi.description: Drive train with 3 dynamically coupled clutches
fmi.generationTool: Dymola Version 2024x Refresh 1, 2024-04-12 (using Inline integration method Explicit Euler and internal fixed step size 0.001)

variables.name: f
variables.description: Frequency of sine function to invoke clutch1

variables.name: J1.w
variables.description: Absolute angular velocity of component (= der(phi))

variables.name: der(J1.w)
variables.description: der(Absolute angular velocity of component (= der(phi)))

variables.name: J1.a
variables.description: Absolute angular acceleration of component (= der(w))

variables.name: clutch1.phi_nominal
variables.description: Nominal value of phi_rel (used for scaling)

variables.name: clutch1.mu_pos[1,1]
variables.description: Positive sliding friction coefficient [-] as function of w_rel [rad/s] (w_rel>=0)

variables.name: clutch1.mu_pos[1,2]
variables.description: Positive sliding friction coefficient [-] as function of w_rel [rad/s] (w_rel>=0)

variables.name: clutch1.peak
variables.description: Peak for maximum value of mu at w==0 (mu0_max = peak*mu_pos[1,2])

variables.name: clutch1.cgeo
variables.description: Geometry constant containing friction distribution assumption

variables.name: clutch1.w_small
variables.description: Relative angular velocity near to zero if jumps due to a reinit(..) of the velocity can occur (set to low value only if such impulses can occur)

variables.name: clutch1.w_relfric
variables.description: Relative angular velocity between frictional surfaces

variables.name: clutch1.a_relfric
variables.description: Relative angular acceleration between frictional surfaces

variables.name: clutch1.tau0
variables.description: Friction torque for w_relfric=0 and forward sliding

variables.name: clutch1.tau0_max
variables.description: Maximum friction torque for w_relfric=0 and locked

variables.name: clutch1.free
variables.description: = true, if frictional element is not active

variables.name: clutch1.sa
variables.description: Path parameter of friction characteristic tau = f(a_relfric)

variables.name: clutch1.startForward
variables.description: = true, if w_relfric=0 and start of forward sliding

variables.name: clutch1.startBackward
variables.description: = true, if w_relfric=0 and start of backward sliding

variables.name: clutch1.locked
variables.description: = true, if w_rel=0 and not sliding

variables.name: clutch1.Unknown
variables.description: Value of mode is not known

variables.name: clutch1.Stuck
variables.description: w_relfric = 0 (forward sliding, locked or backward sliding)

variables.name: clutch1.mode
variables.description: Mode of friction (-1: backward sliding, 0: stuck, 1: forward sliding, 2: inactive, 3: unknown)

variables.name: clutch1.lossPower
variables.description: Loss power leaving component via heatPort (> 0, if heat is flowing out of component)

variables.name: clutch1.mu0
variables.description: Friction coefficient for w=0 and forward sliding

variables.name: clutch1.f_normalized
variables.description: Normalized force signal 0..1 (normal force = fn_max*f_normalized; clutch is engaged if > 0)

variables.name: step1.startTime
variables.description: Output y = offset for time < startTime
